description: Tracks the state of an active or recently completed rest period. Only populated when the player is resting or has just finished resting.

fields.resting: boolean — true while a rest is actively in progress
fields.hours_completed: number or null — hours of rest completed so far
fields.total_hours_needed: number or null — total hours required for this rest
fields.watch_order: array of strings or null — names of those standing watch and their order, if watches are being kept
fields.interruptions: array of strings — any events that interrupted the rest
fields.spells_prepared: array of strings or null — spells prepared during this rest (for spellcasters)
fields.hp_recovered: number or null — HP recovered during this rest
fields.rest_complete: boolean — true once the rest has fully concluded

notes: Set resting to false and rest_complete to true when the outcome describes the rest ending.
Clear this context (return {}) when the player resumes adventuring after a completed rest.
hp_recovered should reflect the amount gained, not the final total — final HP comes from canonical_hp.
